`data_upd_time` as `data_upd_time`

`isc_ads`.`ads_isc_mgf_tooling_work_order_a_min`

where

1=1

and `org_name1`!=('机加中心')

and `org_name1`!=('机加中心')

(`work_order_type`='保养工单')

and (

`period_d`>='2026-10-01'

AND `period_d`<='2026-10-26'

)

LIMIT

1000

) AS dc_2
